cacheHint.zh-CN:
📁 完整输出已保存：{path}
如需调整搜索条件，直接 grep/read 该文件即可，无需重跑命令。
cacheHint.en-US:
📁 Full output saved to: {path}
To adjust the filter, grep/read the file directly; no need to re-run the command.

squashFromDescription.zh-CN: 要压缩的起始 user turn 索引，来自 session_log。
squashFromDescription.en-US: Starting user-turn index to squash, from session_log.

finalizeDocPathDescription.zh-CN: 主 agent 实际写入的交接文档路径（必须在会话工具临时目录内）。
finalizeDocPathDescription.en-US: Path of the handoff document the agent actually wrote (must be inside the session-tools temp dir).

validateInputNotFound.zh-CN: 找不到 user message 索引 {from}。

validateInputIncomplete.zh-CN: user message {from} 尚未完成，不能压缩未完成的 turn。
validateInputIncomplete.en-US: User message {from} is not complete yet; cannot squash an unfinished turn.

validateOverlap.zh-CN: 索引 {from} 已落在已有后缀折叠范围内；当前 MVP 只允许从上一次折叠之后的新 user turn 开始。
validateOverlap.en-US: Index {from} is already inside an existing squash range; the current MVP only allows starting from a new user turn after the previous squash.

logDescription.zh-CN: 列出对话里你的每条消息（编号、内容、是否已回复），给 session_squash 挑压缩起点用。
logDescription.en-US: List your messages in the conversation (index, content, replied or not) so session_squash can pick a starting point.

logSnippet.zh-CN: 列出你的消息和可压缩起点
logSnippet.en-US: List your messages and squash starting points

squashDescription.zh-CN: 把从指定消息开始的对话压缩成一份摘要，释放上下文空间。原对话不删，/tree 可找回。适用时机：一个任务做完、对话太长、准备开新任务。先用 session_log 看编号。
squashDescription.en-US: Squash the conversation from a chosen message into a summary to free up context. Nothing is deleted; use /tree to go back. Good times to use it: a task just finished, the conversation got long, or a new task is about to start. Run session_log first to pick an index.

guidelineBoundary.zh-CN: 一个任务做完、对话变长、准备开新任务时，主动调用 session_squash 压缩对话，让新任务在干净的上下文里开始。
guidelineBoundary.en-US: Call session_squash when a task is done, the conversation grows long, or a new task is about to start, so the next task begins with a clean context.

guidelineIndex.zh-CN: 先调用 session_log 看消息编号，选已完成任务的第一条消息作为 from。
guidelineIndex.en-US: Call session_log first and use the first message of the finished task as from.

guidelineLeaf.zh-CN: 压缩范围是 from 到对话末尾；from 之后聊的内容都会一起压进去。
guidelineLeaf.en-US: Everything from the chosen message to the latest one gets squashed, including anything said after.

guidelineContinue.zh-CN: 压缩完会自动继续干活；想停下来就直接打断。
guidelineContinue.en-US: The agent keeps working automatically after the squash; interrupt it if you want to pause.

pending.zh-CN: 已经有一个压缩请求在排队，等这轮说完就执行，别重复调用。
pending.en-US: A squash is already queued and will run when this turn ends; do not call again.

registered.zh-CN: 好的，从第 {from} 条消息开始压缩。等这轮说完就执行，原对话不删。
registered.en-US: Got it, squashing from message {from}. It runs when this turn ends; the original conversation is kept.

switched.zh-CN: 会话换了，排队中的压缩请求已取消。
switched.en-US: The session changed, so the queued squash was cancelled.

noInput.zh-CN: 找不到要压缩的起始消息，本次未执行。
noInput.en-US: Could not find the starting message; nothing was squashed.

noLeaf.zh-CN: 当前会话没有可压缩的内容。
noLeaf.en-US: There is nothing to squash in this session.

taskPrompt.zh-CN:
【内部任务】把本次对话从第 {from} 条用户消息（开头：“{preview}”）到结尾的内容压缩为一份交接摘要，让后续工作能直接续做。核心不是复述聊天，而是保住准确停点、最终有效状态、错误与未完成事项。

要求：
1. 用 write 工具写入：{docPath}
2. 九个章节按此顺序，无内容写 None observed，不得省略：
   # Handoff: <主题>
   ## Current focus（目标、准确停点，含 ### Background and problem origin：触发 → 问题 → 已验证调查 → 为什么仍需继续）
   ## Errors and resolutions（仍影响任务的错误保留原文或制品路径）
   ## Code and artifact state
   ## Environment and repository state（工作目录、分支、commit、验证环境）
   ## Completed work and decisions（被否决的方案只在影响后续决策时保留）
   ## Active issues and next actions（未完成事项、风险、完成条件）
   ## Important context and boundaries（未提交改动单独标注；脱敏 token/密码/私有 URL）
   ## Suggested skills
3. 关键陈述按需标记 VERIFIED / INFERRED / UNKNOWN / NOT VERIFIED / BLOCKED，推断不得写成事实；未运行的验证必须标 NOT VERIFIED。
4. 已有 PRD、ADR、commit、日志等制品时引用路径，不复制全文。
5. 写完回读确认内容完整，然后调用 session_squash_finalize，docPath 填实际写入的路径。
6. 这是内部任务：不改代码、不跑命令、不创建 commit，只写这份摘要。
taskPrompt.en-US:
[Internal task] Squash this conversation from user message {from} (starts with: “{preview}”) to the end into a handoff summary that lets the work resume directly. The point is not to retell the chat, but to preserve the exact stopping point, the final effective state, errors, and unfinished items.

Requirements:
1. Use the write tool to save it to: {docPath}
2. Nine sections in this exact order; write None observed where empty, never omit:
   # Handoff: <topic>
   ## Current focus (objective, exact stopping point, with ### Background and problem origin: trigger → problem → verified investigation → why it must continue)
   ## Errors and resolutions (keep original text or artifact paths for errors that still matter)
   ## Code and artifact state
   ## Environment and repository state (cwd, branch, commits, verification setup)
   ## Completed work and decisions (rejected approaches only if they affect future decisions)
   ## Active issues and next actions (unfinished items, risks, completion criteria)
   ## Important context and boundaries (mark uncommitted changes separately; redact tokens/passwords/private URLs)
   ## Suggested skills
3. Label key claims VERIFIED / INFERRED / UNKNOWN / NOT VERIFIED / BLOCKED as needed; never present inference as fact; anything not actually verified must be NOT VERIFIED.
4. Reference artifacts (PRDs, ADRs, commits, logs) by path instead of copying them.
5. Read the file back to confirm it is complete, then call session_squash_finalize with docPath set to the path you wrote.
6. This is an internal task: do not edit code, run commands, or create commits — only write this summary.

abandoned.zh-CN: 主 agent 没交出摘要，本次压缩已取消，可以重试。
abandoned.en-US: The agent did not submit a summary; the squash was cancelled. You can retry.

contextHint.zh-CN: 【提示】对话已经很长了（{tokens}）。手头工作告一段落的话，建议先 session_log 再 session_squash 压缩一下；正忙就忽略。
contextHint.en-US: [Notice] The conversation is quite long now ({tokens}). If your work is at a good stopping point, run session_log then session_squash to tidy up; otherwise ignore this.

contextHintNotice.zh-CN: 对话已达 {tokens}，已提醒主 agent 考虑压缩。
contextHintNotice.en-US: Conversation reached {tokens}; the agent has been nudged to squash.

configInvalid.zh-CN: 配置 {path} 解析失败，已用默认阈值。
configInvalid.en-US: Failed to parse {path}; default thresholds are used.

configInvalidEnv.zh-CN: 环境变量 {env} 解析失败，已用默认阈值。
configInvalidEnv.en-US: Could not parse env var {env}; default thresholds are used.

finalizeDescription.zh-CN: 内部任务专用：写完摘要文档后调用，提交文档路径。其他情况不要调用。
finalizeDescription.en-US: For the internal task only: call it after writing the summary document to submit its path. Do not call it otherwise.

finalizeSnippet.en-US: Submit the summary after writing it

finalizeNoPending.zh-CN: 当前没有压缩任务，已忽略。

finalizeNotTask.zh-CN: 还没轮到提交摘要，已忽略。
finalizeNotTask.en-US: Not expecting a summary yet; ignored.

finalizePathDenied.zh-CN: 摘要文档必须写在指定的临时目录里。
finalizePathDenied.en-US: The summary must be written inside the designated temp directory.

finalizeEmpty.zh-CN: 摘要文档是空的，重写后再提交。
finalizeEmpty.en-US: The summary is empty; rewrite it and submit again.

done.zh-CN: 压缩完成。摘要：{docPath}（原对话可用 /tree 找回）。
done.en-US: Squash complete. Summary: {docPath} (use /tree to go back).
